text.brief: A chemist at a Customs laboratory in Chicago opens a parcel declared as industrial dye in May 2027. The powder matches a precursor the Party scheduled in 2025, and the invoice routes through a trading house in Hyderabad.
text.record: The Party agreed in November 2025 to control more fentanyl precursors after the Busan meeting ([White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/11/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-strikes-deal-on-economic-and-trade-relations-with-china/)). On February 20, 2026 the Supreme Court struck down the tariffs imposed under emergency powers, the fentanyl tariff among them ([SCOTUSblog](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/learning-resources-inc-v-trump/)). American overdose deaths fell in 2024 and 2025 ([CDC NCHS: overdose deaths 2025 (May 13, 2026)](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/pressroom/releases/20260513.html); [CDC NCHS: overdose deaths 2024 (May 14, 2025)](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/pressroom/releases/20250514.html)).
text.reading: Enforcement becomes a dial the Party turns with the trade calendar. Cooperation tightens before summits and loosens during disputes, while brokers shift to unscheduled analogues and third-country routes. The opium trade ran the other way in 1839, and the Party remembers which side paid. This is Stratagem 16, let the enemy off in order to catch them.
text.coreEvent: The Party suspends or visibly slows precursor enforcement cooperation during a trade dispute before 2029.
text.gapText: Application Architecture. Enforcement depends on the Party's cooperation, and the Party times that cooperation to its own calendar.
text.fix: Build enforcement that works without the Party's cooperation through designations, chemical tracing and payment analytics.
